recipe.ClayTree.description: A Clay Tree is a good source of Lithium, but it isn't generated in the Overworld. A sapling of Clay Tree is obtained by irradiating a vanilla sapling, planted on the ground, with Clay Laser. The energy value of Clay Laser must be higher than 1000.
recipe.CobblestoneGenerator.description: As you know, a cobblestone generator is consist of water and lava. Clayium's Cobblestone Generator also needs them. If you place both of them next to the machine, it will work.
recipe.QuartzCrucible.description: Quartz Crucible is a device to get the first Silicon Ingot. Throw Impure Silicon Ingots in a Quartz Crucible, wait a few seconds, and throw a String in it.
recipe.SaltExtractor.description: A Salt Extractor is used to extract Salt from water. To run the machine, place water next to it.
recipe.SolarClayFabricator.description: Requires an unobstructed view of the sky.

tooltip.CAReactor.line10: - The tiers of Reactor coils (and Interfaces) >= the Reactor Core's.
tooltip.CAReactor.line3: The Reactor's rank(the mean of the ranks of its components)
tooltip.CAReactor.line4: determines how much compressed Pure Antimatter it produces.
tooltip.CAReactor.line6: Place CA Reactor Coils in the shape of a ring,
tooltip.CAReactor.line7: cover them with CA Reactor Hulls (or Interfaces),
tooltip.CAReactor.line8: and replace one of the hulls with a CA Reactor Core.
tooltip.CAReactor.line9: - The number of CA Reactor Hulls >= 50.
tooltip.CAReactorCoil.line2: - Its six surfaces must be covered by other blocks.
tooltip.CAReactorCoil.line3: - The number of adjacent coil must be 2.
